features.name: Banchory Lodge Hotel West Lodge And Gatepiers
alternativeNames: WEST LODGE AND GATEPIERS BANCHORY LODGE HOTEL
features.shortDescription: WEST LODGE AND GATEPIERS BANCHORY LODGE HOTEL
features.fullDescription: Earlier 19th century. Single storey, 3-bay lodge with rear wing. Harled with granite margins, granite porch with panelled piers. SW and NW angled and swept up to deep eaves. Single and bipartite sash and case, 2-pane windows. Diamond stacks, slate roof. Low granite gatepiers with ball finials.
